recruiterCard.summary: Built a step-by-step sorting visualizer that compares runtime, comparisons and swaps across input distributions, with a model that predicts complexity class and runtime.
impactBullets: Built Next.js visualizations comparing sorting algorithms step by step across input distributions.
Trained a scikit-learn model, served through FastAPI, that predicts complexity class and runtime from input characteristics.
Connected algorithm education with predictive analysis instead of a static visual demo.
